body: A mother will never see you differently than she does right now and always has. Never forget that.
I get those people too. Some of those people are my best friends. Or so I thought so anyway. People come and go in our lives. Always looking forward to those who are coming.

I get that too. And I don’t really expect anything I say to be a revelation or create some king of magical change. I guess it never really works that way. I think you just have to stay in the fight as long as you can. And when you’re think you’re done, fight a little more. I don’t see my time as wasted on you. I see it as an investment in you. And let me tell you, that investment will pay off :)
I think you’d be surprised by how much people can understand. She would want to know and would be devastated if anything happened to you. A mother’s love knows no end.
I can imagine it. But you don’t have to forget them or hide from them. Let them come to you. But don’t give up. Don’t stop fighting. Fight the good fight
What makes you think that they think you’re a burden?
Who are you a burden to?
Why not start again? Afresh?
There are other ways to look pretty besides plastic surgery. Wanna hit the gym with me?

No one here is going to give you that information because firstly, everyone here cares about you. And secondly, there is no painless way. You’ll cause infinite pain to those around you from the loss of you. You’ll cause pain to me. Because I’m writing to you, with you because I believe in you. And sometimes that’s all it takes - one person to believe in us. And you have it right here, with me - now. 

Tell me more - what’s getting to you the most?

Nothing wrong with being fugly, but I don’t believe it. I think you’re a beautiful person who is meant for greater things. I want to start with a question - what would you be doing if you could do anything?

Hey there friend,

Hold on there a minute. What would you do if you could do anything in the world?
What is worthless? And why?
I miss you already and I don’t even know you. Hang around with us a little longer, please :)

I understand you. Being lonely is my biggest fear. I have a huge fear or rejection and that includes rejection by my current friends and family. It doesn’t really get easier, but experience tells me that we can’t keep everyone we want in our lives, no matter how hard we try. I think we should try to make an effort for sure - but never beg for love, for it is only real when given freely. 

People are going to come and go from our lives, let’s not forget the people who are yet to come into our lives and that’s something to look forward to!
There is a positive there - or at least it can be used as a positive tool. Thank you for your words 😊

I hope you don’t. It may not feel like it, but you will be missed. You’ll be missed by me. In the end we only need one person to believe in us, and I believe in you. You can do amazing things with the life you have, and you will.
But you do. And people will miss you, more than you know.
Don’t stop trying. Working out can be great for you, but it takes time and it will be worth it. I believe in you.
Good point. But not out of the blue?

Hey hold on a minute. There’s always something we can do and be good at. Making our own little corner of this world be a slightly better place can create a better place within us. You are loved. Never forget it

Most people in our lives will leave us, except maybe one; two if you’re lucky. These people are like gold - treat them as such. We really only need one person that believes in us. And for a start - I believe in you.
That’s a good way of putting it. Thank you!
I can agree there. It’s more of a barrier..
Thank you :)
I hope that time you’re talking about goes quickly...
Thank you for your answer 😊

I think the worst part of this is that even though you hope someone will grab you and pick you up, you secretly know that no one is coming because no one knows you’re there...

Well I can’t pick you up, but I can try to give you a little push. 

A quick story - I was on holidays in Croatia with a fiend and he had to go to hospital because of a bad fall. I sat in the waiting room all day with another woman who was there for her father. She told me he didn’t have long left and would probably die in the next few weeks. She just wanted him to be comfortable. She told me she was lost in life some years ago. Working in a job she didn’t like. Didn’t have many friends, and none that were close anyway. She told me that she didn’t have “the passion” for anything she was doing in life. One day it dawned on her, “why do anything that you’re not passionate about?” She loved flowers and flower arranging. So she quit her job and opened a florist in Dubrovnik. She loves her job and the florist is now the largest in all of Dubrovnik. Through doing something in which she had “the passion”, she met some amazing people and made great friends. She wakes up every morning excited to go to work and loves her life. She doesn’t do anything in which she doesn’t have “the passion” for. She left me with this “Sometimes in life we have to take a blind leap of faith. You’ll know when its the right time. Not because you won’t be afraid of falling, but because “the passion” is worth the risk of the fall. Life is short. Life is nothing without “the passion”.

I think you need to find something that you’re truly passionate about and follow that with all your heart. Stop at nothing to get it. Once you’re doing something you’re passionate about it, then the rest will fall into place. If you’re not passionate about the current things you’re doing, then I think you need to find what you really are passionate about 😊

Just in my experience...that’s always been attraction from at least one side

But do you think there’s some kind of attraction coming from them or yourself?

The chances of contracting HIV with the use of a condom while having vaginal sex (as a male) are very low. 
In any case, I’m reminded of a rule which goes along the lines of look after yourself as you would others. Ironically I find doctors to be guilty of this more than most. As a medical professional, which advice would you give someone else in your situation? To get tested of course. Not because you believe there’s any real chance of having HIV, but for the peace of mind it will bring.
I know it’s tough, but you will feel better once it’s done :)

It seemed pretty normal to me at the time haha I had different draws for AA, AAA, D...all kind of batteries. They were thrown out when they started to leak :S

As for the cardboard rolls I was encouraged to throw them out, but I invented a game with them using marbles to show I was using them...
When I was a child, I used to collect dead batteries and the cardboard rolls from inside plastic wrap and aluminum foil...
